codeunit 50001 "DropShip SO to PO"
{
    //to avoid error if the sales order fields weren't clean up
    [EventSubscriber(ObjectType::Codeunit, Codeunit::"Purch.-Post", 'OnCheckAssociatedOrderLinesOnAfterSetFilters', '', false, false)]
    local procedure CU_SalesPost_OnCheckAssociatedOrderLinesOnAfterSetFilters(var PurchaseLine: Record "Purchase Line")
    var
        SalesOrderLine: Record "Sales Line";
    begin
        if PurchaseLine.FindSet() then
            repeat
                if not SalesOrderLine.Get(
                SalesOrderLine."Document Type"::Order,
                PurchaseLine."Sales Order No.",
                PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No.") then begin //sales order not longer exist, then clean the linked fields
                    PurchaseLine."Sales Order No." := '';
                    PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No." := 0;
                    PurchaseLine.Modify();
                end;
            until PurchaseLine.Next() = 0;
    end;

    [EventSubscriber(ObjectType::Codeunit, Codeunit::"Sales-Post", 'OnAfterUpdateAfterPosting', '', false, false)]
    local procedure CU_SalesPost_OnAfterUpdateAfterPosting(sender: Codeunit "Sales-Post"; var SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header"; var TempSalesLine: Record "Sales Line" temporary)
    begin
        if SalesHeader."Document Type" <> SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order then
            exit;

        sender.ResetTempLines(TempSalesLine);
        TempSalesLine.SetFilter("Purch. Order Line No.", '<>0');
        if TempSalesLine.FindSet() then
            repeat
                if TempSalesLine.Quantity = TempSalesLine."Quantity Invoiced" then //everything is invoiced
                    UpdateAssocLines(TempSalesLine);
            until TempSalesLine.Next() = 0;
    end;

    procedure UpdateAssocLines(var SalesOrderLine: Record "Sales Line")
    var
        PurchOrderLine: Record "Purchase Line";
    begin
        if not PurchOrderLine.Get(
            PurchOrderLine."Document Type"::Order,
            SalesOrderLine."Purchase Order No.", SalesOrderLine."Purch. Order Line No.")
         then
            exit;

        PurchOrderLine."Sales Order No." := '';
        PurchOrderLine."Sales Order Line No." := 0;
        PurchOrderLine.Modify();
        SalesOrderLine."Purchase Order No." := '';
        SalesOrderLine."Purch. Order Line No." := 0;
        SalesOrderLine.Modify();
    end;


    [EventSubscriber(ObjectType::Table, Database::"Purchase Header", 'OnBeforeCheckShipToCodeChange', '', false, false)]
    local procedure OnBeforeCheckShipToCodeChange(PurchaseHeader: Record "Purchase Header"; var IsHandled: Boolean)
    begin
        IsHandled := true;
    end;

    [EventSubscriber(ObjectType::Table, Database::"Sales Line", 'OnBeforeValidateUnitCostLCYOnGetUnitCost', '', false, false)]
    local procedure OnBeforeValidateUnitCostLCYOnGetUnitCost(var IsHandled: Boolean; var SalesLine: Record "Sales Line")
    var
    // Item: Record Item;
    begin
        // if (SalesLine.Type = SalesLine.Type::Item) and (Item.Get(SalesLine."No.")) then begin
        //     SalesLine.Validate("Unit Cost (LCY)", Item

        if SalesHeader."Document Type" <> SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order then
            exit;

        sender.ResetTempLines(TempSalesLine);
        TempSalesLine.SetFilter("Purch. Order Line No.", '<>0');
        if TempSalesLine.FindSet() then
            repeat
                if TempSalesLine.Quantity = TempSalesLine."Quantity Invoiced" then //everything is invoiced
                    UpdateAssocLines(TempSalesLine);
            until TempSalesLine.Next() = 0;
    end;

    procedure UpdateAssocLines(var SalesOrderLine: Record "Sales Line")
    var
        PurchOrderLine: Record "Purchase Line";
    begin
        if not PurchOrderLine.Get(
            PurchOrderLine."Document Type"::Order,
            SalesOrderLine."Purchase Order No.", SalesOrderLine."Purch. Order Line No.")
         then
            exit;

        PurchOrderLine."Sales Order No." := '';
        PurchOrderLine."Sales Order Line No." := 0;
        PurchOrderLine.Modify();
        SalesOrderLine."Purchase Order No." := '';
        SalesOrderLine."Purch. Order Line No." := 0;
        SalesOrderLine.Modify();
    end;

    begin
        IsHandled := true;
    end;

    //To skip question (update lines) when updating shipment date on sales order header
    [EventSubscriber(ObjectType::Table, Database::"Sales Header", OnBeforeValidateShipmentDate, '', false, false)]
    local procedure T_SalesHeader_OnBeforeValidateShipmentDate(var SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header"; var IsHandled: Boolean)
    begin
        if SalesHeader."Document Type" <> SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order then
            exit;

        SalesHeader.UpdateSalesLinesByFieldNo(SalesHeader.FieldNo("Shipment Date"), false);
        IsHandled := true;
    end;

    CurrentFieldNo: Integer;

OReleased: Boolean;
        POReleased: Boolean;
        Approved: Boolean;
        TolPct: Decimal;
        MinTolQty: Decimal;
        MaxTolQty: Decimal;
        NewQty: Decimal;
        UpdQty: Boolean;
        Text008Err: Label 'You cannot receive more than %1 units.';
        Text009Err: Label 'You cannot receive more than %1 base units.';
    begin
        //BOY001 BEGIN
        IsHandled := true;
        If PurchaseHeader.Get(PurchaseLine."Document Type", PurchaseLine."Document No.") then;
        IF (CallingFieldNo = PurchaseLine.FieldNo("Qty. to Receive")) AND (PurchaseLine."Qty. to Receive" > 0) AND (PurchaseLine."Qty. to Receive" <> PurchaseLine."Outstanding Quantity") THEN BEGIN
            UpdQty := FALSE;
            NewQty := 0.0;
            HasErr := FALSE;
            PurchasesPayablesSetup.Get();
            TolPct := PurchasesPayablesSetup."Over/Under Quantity Tolerance" / 100;
            MinTolQty := PurchaseLine.Quantity * (1 - TolPct);
            MaxTolQty := PurchaseLine.Quantity * (1 + TolPct);
            NewQty := PurchaseLine."Qty. to Receive" + PurchaseLine."Quantity Received";
            IF NewQty > PurchaseLine.Quantity THEN BEGIN
                IF NewQty <= MaxTolQty THEN
                    UpdQty := TRUE
                ELSE
                    ERROR(Text008Err, MaxTolQty - PurchaseLine."Quantity Received");
            END
            ELSE
                IF NewQty < PurchaseLine.Quantity THEN IF NewQty >= MinTolQty THEN UpdQty := TRUE;
            IF UpdQty THEN BEGIN
                IF (PurchaseLine."Sales Order No." <> '') AND (PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No." <> 0) THEN
                    IF NOT SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order, PurchaseLine."Sales Order No.", PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No.") THEN BEGIN
                        MESSAGE('Sales Order %1 - Line %2 not found.', PurchaseLine."Sales Order No.", PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No.");
                        HasErr := TRUE;
                    END
                    ELSE
                        IF SalesLine."Quantity Shipped" > NewQty THEN BEGIN
                            MESSAGE('Sales Order %1 - Line %2 quantity shipped (%3) is greater than %4.', PurchaseLine."Sales Order No.", PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No.", SalesLine."Quantity Shipped", NewQty);
                            HasErr := TRUE;
                        END
                        ELSE BEGIN
                            SalesHeader.GET(SalesLine."Document Type", SalesLine."Document No.");
                            IF SalesHeader.Status <> SalesHeader.Status::Open THEN BEGIN
                                ReleaseSalesDocument.PerformManualReopen(SalesHeader);
                                SOReleased := true;
                            END;
                            SalesLine.FIND('=');
                            SalesLine.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
                            SalesLine."Purchase Order No." := '';
                            SalesLine."Purch. Order Line No." := 0;
                            SalesLine.VALIDATE(Quantity, NewQty);
                            SalesLine."Purch

        //BOY001 BEGIN

        IF (CallingFieldNo = PurchaseLine.FieldNo("Qty. to Receive")) AND (PurchaseLine."Qty. to Receive" > 0) AND (PurchaseLine."Qty. to Receive" <> PurchaseLine."Outstanding Quantity") THEN BEGIN
            UpdQty := FALSE;
            NewQty := 0.0;
            HasErr := FALSE;
            PurchasesPayablesSetup.Get();
            TolPct := PurchasesPayablesSetup."Over/Under Quantity Tolerance" / 100;
            MinTolQty := PurchaseLine.Quantity * (1 - TolPct);
            MaxTolQty := PurchaseLine.Quantity * (1 + TolPct);
            NewQty := PurchaseLine."Qty. to Receive" + PurchaseLine."Quantity Received";
            IF NewQty > PurchaseLine.Quantity THEN BEGIN
                IF NewQty <= MaxTolQty THEN
                    UpdQty := TRUE
                ELSE
                    ERROR(Text008Err, MaxTolQty - PurchaseLine."Quantity Received");
            END
            ELSE
                IF NewQty < PurchaseLine.Quantity THEN IF NewQty >= MinTolQty THEN UpdQty := TRUE;
            IF UpdQty THEN BEGIN
                IF (PurchaseLine."Sales Order No." <> '') AND (PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No." <> 0) THEN
                    IF NOT SalesLine.GET(SalesLine."Document Type"::Order, PurchaseLine."Sales Order No.", PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No.") THEN BEGIN
                        MESSAGE('Sales Order %1 - Line %2 not found.', PurchaseLine."Sales Order No.", PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No.");
                        HasErr := TRUE;
                    END
                    ELSE
                        IF SalesLine."Quantity Shipped" > NewQty THEN BEGIN
                            MESSAGE('Sales Order %1 - Line %2 quantity shipped (%3) is greater than %4.', PurchaseLine."Sales Order No.", PurchaseLine."Sales Order Line No.", SalesLine."Quantity Shipped", NewQty);
                            HasErr := TRUE;
                        END
                        ELSE BEGIN
                            SalesHeader.GET(SalesLine."Document Type", SalesLine."Document No.");
                            IF SalesHeader.Status <> SalesHeader.Status::Open THEN BEGIN
                                ReleaseSalesDocument.PerformManualReopen(SalesHeader);
                                SOReleased := true;
                            END;
                            SalesLine.FIND('=');

    procedure CarryOutBatchAction(var ReqLine2: Record "Requisition Line")
    var
        ReqLine: Record "Requisition Line";
        IsHandled: Boolean;
    begin
        ReqLine.Copy(ReqLine2);
        ReqLine.SetRange("Accept Action Message", true);
        IsHandled := false;
        OnBeforeCarryOutBatchActionCode(ReqLine, ReqLine2, IsHandled);
        if IsHandled then exit;
        Code(ReqLine);
        ReqLine2 := ReqLine;
    end;

    local procedure CheckLocation(RequisitionLine: Record "Requisition Line")
    var
        InventorySetup: Record "Inventory Setup";
    begin
        InventorySetup.Get();
        if InventorySetup."Location Mandatory" then RequisitionLine.TestField("Location Code");
    end;

    local procedure CheckInsertFinalizePurchaseOrderHeader(RequisitionLine: Record "Requisition Line";
    var PurchOrderHeader: Record "Purchase Header";
    UpdateAddressDetails: Boolean;
    CheckCustomer: Boolean): Boolean
    var
        CheckInsert: Boolean;
    begin
        CheckInsert := (PurchOrderHeader."Buy-from Vendor No." <> RequisitionLine."Vendor No.") or CheckCustomer and (PurchOrderHeader."Sell-to Customer No." <> RequisitionLine."Sell-to Customer No.") or (PrevShipToCode <> RequisitionLine."Ship-to Code") or (PurchOrderHeader."Order Address Code" <> RequisitionLine."Order Address Code") or (PurchOrderHeader."Currency Code" <> RequisitionLine."Currency Code") or (PrevPurchCode <> RequisitionLine."Purchasing Code") or CheckAddressDetails(RequisitionLine."Sales Order No.", RequisitionLine."Sales Order Line No.", UpdateAddressDetails);
        OnBeforeCheckInsertFinalizePurchaseOrderHeader(RequisitionLine, PurchOrderHeader, CheckInsert, OrderCounter, PrevPurchCode, PrevLocationCode, PrevShipToCode, UpdateAddressDetails);
        exit(CheckInsert);
    end;

    local procedure CheckDropShptAddressDetails(SalesNo: Code[20];
    UpdateAddressDetails: Boolean): Boolean
    var
        SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header";
        DropShptNameAddressDetails: Text;
    begin
        SalesHeader.Get(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order, SalesNo);
        DropShptNameAddressDetails := SalesHeader."Ship-to Name" + SalesHeader."Ship-to Name 2" + SalesHeader."Ship-to Address" + SalesHeader."Ship-to Address 2" + SalesHeader."Ship-to Post Code" + SalesHeader."Ship-to City" + SalesHeader."Ship-to Contact";
        if NameAddressDetails = '' then NameAddressDetails := DropShptNameAddressDetails;
        if NameAddressDetails = DropShptNameAddressDetails then exit(true);
        if UpdateAddressDetails then NameAddressDetails := DropShptNameAddressDetails;
        exit(false);
    end;

    local procedure CheckInsertFinalizePurchaseOrderHeader(RequisitionLine: Record "Requisition Line";
    var PurchOrderHeader: Record "Purchase Header";
    UpdateAddressDetails: Boolean;
    CheckCustomer: Boolean): Boolean
    var
        CheckInsert: Boolean;
    begin
        CheckInsert := (PurchOrderHeader."Buy-from Vendor No." <> RequisitionLine."Vendor No.") or CheckCustomer and (PurchOrderHeader."Sell-to Customer No." <> RequisitionLine."Sell-to Customer No.") or (PrevShipToCode <> RequisitionLine."Ship-to Code") or (PurchOrderHeader."Order Address Code" <> RequisitionLine."Order Address Code") or (PurchOrderHeader."Currency Code" <> RequisitionLine."Currency Code") or (PrevPurchCode <> RequisitionLine."Purchasing Code") or CheckAddressDetails(RequisitionLine."Sales Order No.", RequisitionLine."Sales Order Line No.", UpdateAddressDetails);
        OnBeforeCheckInsertFinalizePurchaseOrderHeader(RequisitionLine, PurchOrderHeader, CheckInsert, OrderCounter, PrevPurchCode, PrevLocationCode, PrevShipToCode, UpdateAddressDetails);
        exit(CheckInsert);
    end;

    local procedure PurchasingParametersMatch(PurchaseHeader: Record "Purchase Header";
    ReqLine: Record "Requisition Line"): Boolean
    begin
        exit((PurchaseHeader."Buy-from Vendor No." = ReqLine."Vendor No.") and (PurchaseHeader."Currency Code" = ReqLine."Currency Code") and (PrevPurchCode = ReqLine."Purchasing Code") and not CheckAddressDetails(ReqLine."Sales Order No.", ReqLine."Sales Order Line No.", false));
    end;

    procedure SetSuppressCommit(NewSuppressCommit: Boolean)
    begin
        SuppressCommit := NewSuppressCommit;
    end;

    procedure PurchaseOrderLineMatchReqLine(ReqLine: Record "Requisition Line"): Boolean
    begin
        if PurchOrderLine."Drop Shipment" then exit((ReqLine."Sales Order No." = PurchOrderLine."Sales Order No.") and (ReqLine."Sales Order Line No." = PurchOrderLine."Sales Order Line No."));
        if PurchOrderLine."Special Order" then exit((ReqLine."Sales Order No." = PurchOrderLine."Special Order Sales No.") and (ReqLine."Sales Order Line No." = PurchOrderLine."Special Order Sales Line No."));
        exit(true);
    end;

    local procedure GetTransferHeader(var TransferHeader: Record "Transfer Header";
    RequisitionLine: Record "Requisition Line")
    begin
        TempTransHeader.SetRange("Transfer-from Code", RequisitionLine."Transfer-from Code");
        TempTransHeader.SetRange("Transfer-to Code", RequisitionLine."Location Code");
        if TempTransHeader.FindFirst() then TransferHeader.Get(TempTransHeader."No.");
    end;

    local procedure SetTransferHeader(TransferHeader: Record "Transfer Header")
    begin
        TempTransHeader := TransferHeader;
        if TempTransHeader.Insert() then;
    end;

    local procedure InitProgressWindow()
    begin
        if ReqTemplate.Recurring then
            Window.Open(Text000 + Text001 + Text002 + Text003 + Text004)
        else
            Window.Open(Text000 + Text001 + Text002 + Text003 + Text005);
    end;

    PlanningResiliency: Boolean;

    end;

    trigger OnAfterGetRecord()
    var
        Item: Record 27;
        ItemUOM: Record 5404;
        ILE2: Record 32;
        ILE3: Record 32;
    begin
        Rec.SETRANGE("User ID", USERID);
        Rec.CALCFIELDS("Qty. On Purchase Order", "Qty. On Sales Order", "Qty. OnHand", "Customer No.");
        Rec.CALCFIELDS("Division Code", "Inside Salesperson Code", "Salesperson Code", "Backup ISR");
        Item.GET(Rec."Item No.");
        IF Item."Base Unit of Measure" <> Item."Sales Unit of Measure" THEN BEGIN
            IF ItemUOM.GET(Rec."Item No.", Item."Sales Unit of Measure") THEN BEGIN
                Rec."Qty. On Purch. Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Purchase Order" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
                Rec."Qty. On Sales Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Sales Order" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
                Rec."Qty. OnHand Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. OnHand" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
            END;
        END
        ELSE BEGIN
            Rec."Qty. On Purch. Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Purchase Order";
            Rec."Qty. On Sales Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Sales Order";
            Rec."Qty. OnHand Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. OnHand";
        END;
        //BOY1220 start
        CLEAR(PalletUOM);
        PalletUOM.SETRANGE(PalletUOM."Item No.", Item."No.");
        PalletUOM.SETRANGE(Code, 'PALLET');
        IF PalletUOM.Findfirst() THEN Rec."No. of Pallets" := Rec."Qty. OnHand" / PalletUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
        //BOY1220 end
        ILE2.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.", "Posting Date");
        ILE2.SETRANGE("Item No.", Rec."Item No.");
        ILE2.SETRANGE("Location Code", Rec."Location Code");
        ILE2.SETRANGE("Entry Type", ILE2."Entry Type"::Purchase);
        IF ILE2.FINDLAST THEN Rec."Last Purchase Date" := ILE2."Pos

    trigger OnAfterGetRecord()
    var
        Item: Record Item;
        ItemUOM: Record "Item Unit of Measure";
        ILE: Record "Item Ledger Entry";
        RemainingValue: Decimal;
        CalcCost: Decimal;
        ILE2: Record "Item Ledger Entry";
        ILE3: Record "Item Ledger Entry";
    begin
        Rec.SETRANGE("User ID", USERID);
        Rec.CALCFIELDS("Qty. On Purchase Order", "Qty. On Sales Order", "Qty. OnHand", "Customer No.");
        Rec.CALCFIELDS("Division Code", "Inside Salesperson Code", "Salesperson Code", "Backup ISR");
        Item.GET(Rec."Item No.");
        IF Item."Base Unit of Measure" <> Item."Sales Unit of Measure" THEN BEGIN
            IF ItemUOM.GET(Rec."Item No.", Item."Sales Unit of Measure") THEN BEGIN
                Rec."Qty. On Purch. Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Purchase Order" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
                Rec."Qty. On Sales Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Sales Order" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
                Rec."Qty. OnHand Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. OnHand" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
            END;
        END
        ELSE BEGIN
            Rec."Qty. On Purch. Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Purchase Order";
            Rec."Qty. On Sales Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Sales Order";
            Rec."Qty. OnHand Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. OnHand";
        END;
        //BOY1220 start
        CLEAR(PalletUOM);
        PalletUOM.SETRANGE(PalletUOM."Item No.", Item."No.");
        PalletUOM.SETRANGE(Code, 'PALLET');
        IF PalletUOM.Findfirst() THEN Rec."No. of Pallets" := Rec."Qty. OnHand" / PalletUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
        //BOY1220 end
        ILE.SETRANGE(Open, TRUE);
        ILE.SETRANGE("Item No.", Rec."Item No.");
        ILE.SETRANGE("Location Code", Rec."Location Code");
        ILE.SETFILTER("Remaining Quantity", '<>%1', 0);
        IF ILE.FIND('-') THEN
            REPEAT
                ILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actua

            END;

        //BOY1220 end
        ILE.SETRANGE(Open, TRUE);
        ILE.SETRANGE("Item No.", Rec."Item No.");
        ILE.SETRANGE("Location Code", Rec."Location Code");
        ILE.SETFILTER("Remaining Quantity", '<>%1', 0);
        IF ILE.FIND('-') THEN
            REPEAT
                ILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)", "Cost Amount (Expected)");
                RemainingValue := 0;
                CalcCost := 0;
                IF ILE."Completely Invoiced" THEN
                    CalcCost := ILE."Cost Amount (Actual)"
                ELSE
                    CalcCost := ILE."Cost Amount (Expected)";
                RemainingValue := (CalcCost / ILE.Quantity) * ILE."Remaining Quantity";
                Rec."Inventory Value" += RemainingValue;
            UNTIL ILE.NEXT = 0;
        ILE2.SETCURRENTKEY(

    trigger OnAfterGetRecord()
    var
        Item: Record Item;
        ItemUOM: Record "Item Unit of Measure";
        ILE: Record "Item Ledger Entry";
        RemainingValue: Decimal;
        CalcCost: Decimal;
        ILE2: Record "Item Ledger Entry";
        ILE3: Record "Item Ledger Entry";
    begin
        Rec.SETRANGE("User ID", USERID);
        Rec.CALCFIELDS("Qty. On Purchase Order", "Qty. On Sales Order", "Qty. OnHand", "Customer No.");
        Rec.CALCFIELDS("Division Code", "Inside Salesperson Code", "Salesperson Code", "Backup ISR");
        Item.GET(Rec."Item No.");
        IF Item."Base Unit of Measure" <> Item."Sales Unit of Measure" THEN BEGIN
            IF ItemUOM.GET(Rec."Item No.", Item."Sales Unit of Measure") THEN BEGIN
                Rec."Qty. On Purch. Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Purchase Order" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
                Rec."Qty. On Sales Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Sales Order" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
                Rec."Qty. OnHand Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. OnHand" / ItemUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
            END;
        END
        ELSE BEGIN
            Rec."Qty. On Purch. Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Purchase Order";
            Rec."Qty. On Sales Order Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. On Sales Order";
            Rec."Qty. OnHand Sales UOM" := Rec."Qty. OnHand";
        END;
        //BOY1220 start
        CLEAR(PalletUOM);
        PalletUOM.SETRANGE(PalletUOM."Item No.", Item."No.");
        PalletUOM.SETRANGE(Code, 'PALLET');
        IF PalletUOM.Findfirst() THEN Rec."No. of Pallets" := Rec."Qty. OnHand" / PalletUOM."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
        //BOY1220 end
        ILE.SETRANGE(Open, TRUE);
        ILE.SETRANGE("Item No.", Rec."Item No.");
        ILE.SETRANGE("Location Code", Rec."Location Code");
        ILE.SETFILTER("Remaining Quantity", '<>%1', 0);
        IF ILE.FIND('-') THEN
            REPEAT
                ILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)", "Cost Amount (Expected)");
                RemainingValue := 0;
                CalcCost := 0;
                IF ILE."Completely Invoiced" THEN
                    CalcCost := ILE."Cost Amount (Actual)"
                ELSE
                    CalcCost := ILE."Cost Amount (Expected)";
                RemainingValue := (CalcCost / ILE.Quantity) * ILE."Remaining Quantity";
                Rec."Inventory Value" += RemainingValue;
            UNTIL ILE.NEXT = 0;
        ILE2.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.", "Posting Date");
        ILE2.SETRANGE("Item No.", Rec."Item No.");
        ILE2.SETRANGE("Location Code", Rec."Location Code");
        ILE2.SETRANGE("Entry Type", ILE2."Entry Type"::Purchase);
        IF ILE2.FINDLAST THEN Rec."Last Purchase Date" := ILE2."Posting Date";
        ILE3.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.", "Posting Date");

                    ShortcutDimension8CodeOnAfterV();
                end;
            }
        }
    }
    trigger OnOpenPage()
    var
    begin
        GeneralLedgerSetup.Get();
        if GeneralLedgerSetup."Shortcut Dimension 8 Code" <> '' then
            Shortcut8visible := true
        else
            Shortcut8visible := false;
    end;

    local procedure ShortcutDimension8CodeOnAfterV()
    begin
        CurrPage.Update();
    end;


    var
        GeneralLedgerSetup: Record "General Ledger Setup";
        Shortcut8visible: Boolean;
}

            trigger OnBeforeAction()
            var
                UserSetup: Record 91;
                Cust: Record 18;
            begin
                IF Cust.GET(Rec."Bill-to Customer No.") THEN
                    Rec."Workflow Approved" := Cust."Approval Bypass"
                ELSE
                    Rec."Workflow Approved" := FALSE;
                Rec.Modify();
                IF Rec."Location Code" = '' THEN ERROR('Please enter a location before sending the order for approval');
                if Rec."BA-Shortcut Dimension 8 Code" = '' then ERROR('Please enter a Industry dimension before sending the order for approval');
                IF Rec."External Document No." = '' THEN ERROR('Please enter an External Document No.');
            end;

    procedure OpenPurchOrderFormBOY()
    var
        PurchaseHeader: Record "Purchase Header";
        PurchaseOrder: Page "Purchase Order";
    begin
        Rec.TestField("Purchase Order No.");
        PurchaseHeader.SetRange("No.", Rec."Purchase Order No.");
        PurchaseOrder.SetTableView(PurchaseHeader);
        PurchaseOrder.Run();
    end;

    procedure OpenSpecialPurchOrderFormBOY()
    var
        PurchaseHeader: Record "Purchase Header";
        PurchRcptHeader: Record "Purch. Rcpt. Header";
        PurchaseOrder: Page "Purchase Order";
    begin
        Rec.TestField("Special Order Purchase No.");
        PurchaseHeader.SetRange("No.", Rec."Special Order Purchase No.");
        if not PurchaseHeader.IsEmpty then begin
            PurchaseOrder.SetTableView(PurchaseHeader);
            PurchaseOrder.Run();
        end
        else begin
            PurchRcptHeader.SetRange("Order No.", Rec."Special Order Purchase No.");
            if PurchRcptHeader.Count = 1 then
                PAGE.Run(PAGE::"Posted Purchase Receipt", PurchRcptHeader)
            else
                PAGE.Run(PAGE::"Posted Purchase Receipts", PurchRcptHeader);
        end;
    end;
}

            action("Documents Unsent")
            {
                ApplicationArea = All;
                Caption = 'Documents Unsent';
                Promoted = true;
                PromotedCategory = Process;
                PromotedIsBig = true;
                ToolTip = 'Executes the Documents Unsent action.';

                trigger OnAction()
                var
                    SalesHdrOut: Record 36;
                    UserSetup: Record 91;
                    PurchSetup: Record 312;
                begin
                    PurchSetup.GET;
                    SalesHdrOut.Reset();
                    SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesHdrOut."Document Type"::Order);
                    SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE(Status, SalesHdrOut.Status::Released);
                    IF UserSetup.GET(USERID) THEN IF UserSetup."Salespers./Purch. Code" <> '' THEN SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE("Backup ISR", UserSetup."Salespers./Purch. Code");
                    IF SalesHdrOut.FIND('-') THEN
                        REPEAT
                            IF SalesHdrOut."Location Code" <> PurchSetup."Drop Ship Location Code" THEN BEGIN
                                IF ((SalesHdrOut."Order Confirmation Sent" = FALSE) OR (SalesHdrOut."Picklist Sent" = FALSE)) THEN SalesHdrOut.MARK(TRUE);
                            END
                            ELSE
                                IF SalesHdrOut."Order Confirmation Sent" = FALSE THEN SalesHdrOut.MARK(TRUE);
                        UNTIL SalesHdrOut.NEXT = 0;
                    SalesHdrOut.MARKEDONLY(TRUE);
                    PAGE.RUN(9305, SalesHdrOut);
                end;
            }

report 50017 "Sales Blanket Order."
{
    // BOY001 KTH 1.30.18 Modify to add same fields as on standard SO report 1305
    DefaultLayout = RDLC;
    RDLCLayout = '.\src\Layout\SalesBlanketOrder.rdlc';

            RequestFilterFields = "No.", "Sell-to Customer No.", "No. Printed";
            RequestFilterHeading = 'Blanket Sales Order';

            column(No_SalesHeader; "No.")
            {
            }
            dataitem("Sales Line"; 37)
            {
                DataItemLink = "Document No." = FIELD("No.");
                DataItemTableView = SORTING("Document Type", "Document No.", "Line No.") WHERE("Document Type" = CONST("Blanket Order"));

                dataitem(SalesLineComments; 44)
                {
                    DataItemLink = "No." = FIELD("Document No."), "Document Line No." = FIELD("Line No.");
                    DataItemTableView = SORTING("Document Type", "No.", "Document Line No.", "Line No.") WHERE("Document Type" = CONST("Blanket Order"), "Print On Order Confirmation" = CONST(true));

                    trigger OnAfterGetRecord()
                    begin
                        InsertTempLine(Comment, 10);
                    end;
                }
                trigger OnAfterGetRecord()
                begin
                    TempSalesLine := "Sales Line";
                    TempSalesLine.INSERT();
                    HighestLineNo := "Line No.";
                    IF ("Sales Header"."Tax Area Code" <> '') AND NOT UseExternalTaxEngine THEN SalesTaxCalc.AddSalesLine(TempSalesLine);
                    //BOY001
                    IF "Sales Line"."No." = '' THEN BEGIN
                        UnitAmount := '';
                        Qty := '';
                        LineAmt := ''
                    END
                    ELSE BEGIN
                        UnitAmount := FORMAT("Sales Line"."Unit Price");
                        Qty := FORMAT("Sales Line".Quantity);
                        LineAmt := FORMAT("Sales Line"."Line Amount");
                    END;
                    //BOY
                end;

                trigger OnPostDataItem()
                begin
                    IF "Sales Header"."Tax Area Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
                        IF UseExternalTaxEngine THEN
                            SalesTaxCalc.CallExternalTaxEngineForSales("Sales Header", TRUE)
                        ELSE
                            SalesTaxCalc.EndSalesTaxCalculation(UseDate);
                        SalesTaxCalc.DistTaxOverSalesLines(TempSalesLine);
                        SalesTaxCalc.GetSummarizedSalesTaxTable(TempSalesTaxAmtLine);
                        BrkIdx := 0;
                        PrevPrintOrder := 0;
                        PrevTaxPercent := 0;
                        TempSalesTaxAmtLine.RESET();
                        TempSalesTaxAmtLine.SETCURRENTKEY(TempSal

    procedure FilterDocumentsUnsentPick(var SalesHdrOut: Record 36);
    var
        SalesLine: Record 37;
        UserSetup: Record 91;
        PurchSetup: Record 312;
    begin
        PurchSetup.Get();
        SalesHdrOut.Reset();
        if UserSetup.Get(UserId) then
            if UserSetup."Salespers./Purch. Code" <> '' then
                SalesHdrOut.SetRange("Inside Salesperson Code", UserSetup."Salespers./Purch. Code");
        SalesHdrOut.SetRange("Document Type", SalesHdrOut."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesHdrOut.SetRange(Status, SalesHdrOut.Status::Released);


        if SalesHdrOut.Find('-') then begin
            repeat
                if SalesHdrOut."Location Code" <> PurchSetup."Drop Ship Location Code" then begin
                    if SalesHdrOut."Picklist Sent" = false then
                        SalesHdrOut.Mark(true);
                end;

            until SalesHdrOut.Next() = 0;
        end;


        SalesHdrOut.MarkedOnly(true);

    end;

    procedure SetRespCenterFilter()
    var
        UserSetupMgt: Codeunit "User Setup Management";
        RespCenterCode: Code[10];
    begin
        RespCenterCode := UserSetupMgt.GetSalesFilter;
        if RespCenterCode <> '' then begin
            FilterGroup(2);
            SetRange("Responsibility Center Filter", RespCenterCode);
            FilterGroup(0);
        end;
        OnAfterSetRespCenterFilter(Rec, RespCenterCode);
    end;

    procedure CalculateAverageDaysDelayed() AverageDays: Decimal
    var
        SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header";
        SumDelayDays: Integer;
        CountDelayedInvoices: Integer;
    begin
        FilterOrders(SalesHeader, FieldNo(Delayed));
        if SalesHeader.FindSet then begin
            repeat
                SummarizeDelayedData(SalesHeader, SumDelayDays, CountDelayedInvoices);
            until SalesHeader.Next() = 0;
            AverageDays := SumDelayDays / CountDelayedInvoices;
        end;
    end;

    procedure CalculateAverageDaysDelayed() AverageDays: Decimal
    var
        SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header";
        SumDelayDays: Integer;
        CountDelayedInvoices: Integer;
    begin
        FilterOrders(SalesHeader, FieldNo(Delayed));
        if SalesHeader.FindSet then begin
            repeat
                SummarizeDelayedData(SalesHeader, SumDelayDays, CountDelayedInvoices);
            until SalesHeader.Next() = 0;
            AverageDays := SumDelayDays / CountDelayedInvoices;
        end;
    end;

    local procedure MaximumDelayAmongLines(SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header") MaxDelay: Integer
    var
        SalesLine: Record "Sales Line";
    begin
        MaxDelay := 0;
        SalesLine.SetRange("Document Type", SalesHeader."Document Type");
        SalesLine.SetRange("Document No.", SalesHeader."No.");
        SalesLine.SetFilter("Shipment Date", '<%1&<>%2', WorkDate, 0D);
        if SalesLine.FindSet then
            repeat
                if WorkDate - SalesLine."Shipment Date" > MaxDelay then
                    MaxDelay := WorkDate - SalesLine."Shipment Date";
            until SalesLine.Next() = 0;
    end;

    procedure CountOrders(FieldNumber: Integer): Integer
    var
        SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header";
        CountSalesOrders: Query "Count Sales Orders";
    begin
        CountSalesOrders.SetRange(Status, SalesHeader.Status::Released);
        CountSalesOrders.SetRange(Completely_Shipped, false);
        FilterGroup(2);
        CountSalesOrders.SetFilter(Responsibility_Center, GetFilter("Responsibility Center Filter"));
        OnCountOrdersOnAfterCountPurchOrdersSetFilters(CountSalesOrders);
        FilterGroup(0);

        case FieldNumber of
            FieldNo("Ready to Ship"):
                begin
                    CountSalesOrders.SetRange(Ship);
                    CountSalesOrders.SetFilter(Shipment_Date, GetFilter("Date Filter2"));
                end;
            FieldNo("Partially Shipped"):
                begin
                    CountSalesOrders.SetRange(Shipped, true);
                    CountSalesOrders.SetFilter(Shipment_Date, GetFilter("Date Filter2"));
                end;
            FieldNo(Delayed):
                begin
                    CountSalesOrders.SetRange(Ship);
                    CountSalesOrders.SetFilter(Date_Filter, GetFilter("Date Filter"));
                    CountSalesOrders.SetRange(Late_Order_Shipping, true);
                end;
        end;
        CountSalesOrders.Open;
        CountSalesOrders.Read;
        exit(CountSalesOrders.Count_Orders);
    end;

        SalesHeader.SetRange(Status, SalesHeader.Status::Released);
        SalesHead

    local procedure FilterOrders(var SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header"; FieldNumber: Integer)
    begin
        SalesHeader.SetRange("Document Type", SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesHeader.SetRange(Status, SalesHeader.Status::Released);
        SalesHeader.SetRange("Completely Shipped", false);
        case FieldNumber of
            FieldNo("Ready to Ship"):
                begin
                    SalesHeader.SetRange(Ship);
                    SalesHeader.SetFilter("Shipment Date", GetFilter("Date Filter2"));
                end;
            FieldNo("Partially Shipped"):
                begin
                    SalesHeader.SetRange(Shipped, true);
                    SalesHeader.SetFilter("Shipment Date", GetFilter("Date Filter2"));
                end;
            FieldNo(Delayed):
                begin
                    SalesHeader.SetRange(Ship);
                    SalesHeader.SetFilter("Date Filter", GetFilter("Date Filter"));
                    SalesHeader.SetRange("Late Order Shipping", true);
                end;
        end;
        FilterGroup(2);
        SalesHeader.SetFilter("Responsibility Center", GetFilter("Responsibility Center Filter"));
        OnFilterOrdersOnAfterSalesHeaderSetFilters(SalesHeader);
        FilterGroup(0);
    end;

    procedure ShowOrders(FieldNumber: Integer)
    var
        SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header";
    begin
        FilterOrders(SalesHeader, FieldNumber);
        Page.Run(Page::"Sales Order List", SalesHeader);
    end;

    local procedure SummarizeDelayedData(var SalesHeader: Record "Sales Header"; var SumDelayDays: Integer; var CountDelayedInvoices: Integer)
    var
        IsHandled: Boolean;
    begin
        IsHandled := false;
        OnBeforeSummarizeDelayedData(SalesHeader, SumDelayDays, CountDelayedInvoices, IsHandled);
        if IsHandled then
            exit;

        SumDelayDays += MaximumDelayAmongLines(SalesHeader);
        CountDelayedInvoices += 1;
    end;

erPendingPrepayment(VAR SalesHdrOut: Record 36);
    VAR
        UserSetup: Record 91;
    BEGIN
        SalesHdrOut.Reset();
        SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesHdrOut."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE(Status, SalesHdrOut.Status::"Pending Prepayment");
        IF UserSetup.GET(USERID) THEN
            IF UserSetup."Salespers./Purch. Code" <> '' THEN SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE("Inside Salesperson Code", UserSetup."Salespers./Purch. Code");
        IF SalesHdrOut.FIND('-') THEN
            REPEAT
                SalesHdrOut.MARK(TRUE);
            UNTIL SalesHdrOut.NEXT() = 0;
        SalesHdrOut.MARKEDONLY(TRUE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE PendingPrepayment(): Integer;
    VAR
        SalesHdr: Record 36;
    BEGIN
        FilterPendingPrepayment(SalesHdr);
        EXIT(SalesHdr.COUNT);
    END;

    PROCEDURE FilterDocumentsUnsent(VAR SalesHdrOut: Record 36);
    VAR
        UserSetup: Record 91;
        PurchSetup: Record 312;
    BEGIN
        PurchSetup.GET();
        SalesHdrOut.Reset();
        SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE("Document Type", SalesHdrOut."Document Type"::Order);
        SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE(Status, SalesHdrOut.Status::Released);
        IF UserSetup.GET(USERID) THEN
            IF UserSetup."Salespers./Purch. Code" <> '' THEN SalesHdrOut.SETRANGE("Inside Salesperson Code", UserSetup."Salespers./Purch. Code");
        IF SalesHdrOut.FIND('-') THEN
            REPEAT
                IF SalesHdrOut."Location Code" <> PurchSetup."Drop Ship Location Code" THEN BEGIN
                    IF ((SalesHdrOut."Order Confirmation Sent" = FALSE) OR (SalesHdrOut."Picklist Sent" = FALSE)) THEN SalesHdrOut.MARK(TRUE);
                END
                ELSE
                    IF SalesHdrOut."Order Confirmation Sent" = FALSE THEN SalesHdrOut.MARK(TRUE);
            UNTIL SalesHdrOut.NEXT() = 0;
        SalesHdrOut.MARKEDONLY(TRUE);
    END;

    PROCEDURE DocumentsUnsent(): Integer;
    VAR
        SalesHdr: Record 36;
    BEGIN
        FilterDocumentsUnsent(SalesHdr);
        EXIT(SalesHdr.COUNT);
    END;
